problem: After a retired first fit is rejected, IQC remains run=0. Calcc can still request SetTXAiqcEnd because its running bit was set before attempting publication. END sets busy and waits for xiqc, but xiqc skips all transitions while run=0. The shared correction-change worker can then no longer execute queued fits.
fix: Under the existing csDSP lock, an already inactive IQC completes END immediately, clears busy and returns; active curves retain the existing ramp.
regression: Create a fresh core, tag then invalidate a fit, invoke the stale first-fit publisher, assert IQC remains off, then request END and verify no pending transition; existing warm/cached-generation checks follow.

before.reason: 15-second test alarm while inactive END waits; observed in tool completion. Empty redirected test log preserved.
